title: Tea Timer Oversteep Incidents
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=teatimer:session tea_name=*
| eval oversteep_seconds=actual_steep_seconds-target_steep_seconds
| where oversteep_seconds>30
| stats count as oversteep_incidents, avg(oversteep_seconds) as avg_oversteep_seconds by tea_name
| sort - oversteep_incidents
description: Counts how often tea sessions run materially past their target steep time.
value: Oversteeping is the easiest way to turn a good tea into a bitter one, so timing drift is worth measuring.
implementation: Export tea-timer sessions with actual and target steep time, then review oversteep incidents by tea.
visualization: Bar chart of oversteep incidents by tea name.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which teas keep getting left too long and turning harsher than you wanted.
